<center>![Hive_woodpeckers_in_wood_no_glass.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/hive-woodpeckers/23x17DPrvaL6wAoitvyLvTSYTEUKFhKUCspfpzQK1tDwipqN5MBmgCa7M7HyQVcchQC5v.jpg)</center>

Good Evening to you all and thanks for stopping by and supporting us.

So today after having a couple of days of funding dropping in to the account, I decided it was time to get some tools that I had been looking at acquiring for a while now.

I ordered a Circular Saw that will speed up our wood cutting a hell of a lot quicker.
Being able to run this across the boards without needing get the big mitre saw out, this will make life a lot easier. Ordered from Amazon for £46.74. A fairly good price for a cheap circular saw. 

The benefit of it coming with 2 blades made this a steal, as long as it works well enough.

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/hive-woodpeckers/48b3aMFm3FG21124Xy2TArv8J3sfxF9oSqL2R1RRzFWcaeetGuXuryNLiFWBVxU1hm.png)


![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/hive-woodpeckers/23w3F6UoUpvrGqAiKmUMn6vFHJ7YYDTcpYDYVDF9ysU3bzqj2HYp45EL2PiaJy58umoAs.png)


![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/hive-woodpeckers/EpVFr3UTKoPLCC38R4Nk82Ye6rWHgPXJpTLAWVbFdj1kfRWWkUxTfXMyCjCNv94wYHB.png)

Annoyingly it's gone down to £44.99 tonight, but if it works it will be well worth the extra £1 odd that we paid.


![hivewoodpeckers_divider.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/hive-woodpeckers/23w2cfiRiaBhThUYHrZecUbMBTHczVJJS8aL47k6mKxsbHY44EcvvRnonWfzCQSf6Va79.png)

As I mentioned in previous posts, I will be using the HBD by selling it to my main account. This is mainly to save on fees. Though I will at times sell it if I cannot afford to buy the equipment for a bit.
This HBD will be being sold so that it allowed me to buy the saw now, instead of waiting another week. 

A total of 66.964 Hive has been sent to Binance to sell for GBP to fund the saw. Around $35.56. The $ to £ conversion is harsh and I will be trying to find much better ways to do this for future sells.

For future posts I will start making a list of what is bought, links to the receipts and costs and I will add them to spreadsheet for easy cross checking.

I will do my best to provide receipts, but it won't always be doable if I buy second hand items. 

Again thankyou to everyone who has supported us, I hope to be able to bring more great news soon!

![hivewoodpeckers_divider.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/hive-woodpeckers/23w2cfiRiaBhThUYHrZecUbMBTHczVJJS8aL47k6mKxsbHY44EcvvRnonWfzCQSf6Va79.png)


<center>![Hive_Woodpeckers_Logo.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/hive-woodpeckers/AJbpkQZS7JpsQRKDdiKKpFGd6mQqRaw7G7GK5egmHjNWjtXYtJ7YF4LGyee2dFG.png)</center>

If you are reading this post and wondering who the [Hive-Woodpeckers](https://peakd.com/hive-177682/@hive-woodpeckers/introduction-to-the-hive-woodpeckers-3cg) are, click the link and check out our introduction post.

I want to say a massive thankyou to everyone who has supported us so far, from words of encouragement to upvotes. You are helping change kids lives and it is an amazing thing to be a part of.

<center>**<u>A big thanks to our sponsors
</u>**</center>
<center>@stickupboys</center>
The coolest folk around making some kick ass Gifs for our pleasure and enjoyment. Along with their great humour, these are top rank Hive members for sure.
<center>![untitled.gif](https://media.tenor.com/BdWoCboyEz8AAAAC/lego-stickupboys.gif)</center>

<center>![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/hive-woodpeckers/23x18nXdwGxAqBpUHwLA89KfaMij2WMhcC3iimQ8BThwU5g6iPHMiLDSDa5VLmmygfQGt.png)</center>

A great group of Splinterlands Guilds who are an amazing community, chatting about all sorts from Life to Crypto.
Come drop by their Discord and meet some amazing people [Phoenix Arcade](https://discord.gg/M3SE9bSAva)

<center> @duo-curator and the HOC </center>
<center>![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/hive-woodpeckers/AKbFNS6LLZ99yvD4wb4B7siCMyLBbjnt3bj6odoXWgHSqyW7V6QQESbNCDgSA99.png)</center>

The Hive Onboarding Committee are a group of Hivians focused on making Hive a better place for newcomers. Supporting them on their journey in Hive and helping them to grow across the chain.
With the use of their Duo Token it is a great project and a generous group.

Check out their Discord [HOC](https://discord.gg/6cRZ5DrRgy) and get to know them. They are a great group and well worth getting to know.

Check out the [Duo-Token](https://peakd.com/@duo-curator) and their posts on Hive.

<center>![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/hive-woodpeckers/23wCbCsNESPxavHaKFDuaapFsDxwJgsokb16w5xgLWkARRrrWe5BLCsYxSgjYnDak67ff.png)</center>
